reference.name: anomalib
reference.alignment: AvgPool2d(3,1,1,count_include_pad=True) both layers; layer3->layer2 via F.interpolate(mode='nearest')
reference.score: k=1 nearest-neighbour patch distance, reweighted by 9-support isolation (1 - softmax(distances))[0]

c1.reason_not_produced: memory infeasible at frozen protocol scale

blocker_reason: canonical PatchCore (0.1 greedy coreset over 1000 train_normal x 7 tiles) needs a 44.0 GB raw embedding matrix (7,168,000 patches x 1536-d float32) plus an 11.2 GB SparseRandomProjection matrix (peak ~55.2 GB) against 34.2 GB total RAM; the ~716,800-patch bank also exceeds the 8 GB GPU for euclidean k-NN + reweighting. Running would require a hand-rolled streaming coreset or shrinking the frozen train/tile/coreset protocol, both excluded by this phase's rules.
